Definition: from G4862 and G622; to destroy (middle voice or passively, be slain) in company with:--perish with.
BiblicalUsage: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with those who believed not, when she received the spies with peace. She lived in a doomed city and threw in her lot with God's people, and faith kept her from perishing with the unbelieving.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that faith sets me apart from a perishing world even while I live in it, and I hold that receiving God's messengers in peace is the mark of that faith.
